panels.title: Net worth change

targets.queryText: WITH nw AS (SELECT date, time, SUM(balance) AS v FROM balances WHERE 1 = 1 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 GROUP BY date) SELECT (SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-30 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "30 days", (SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-90 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "90 days", (SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), 'start of year', '-1 day') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "YTD", (SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-1 year') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "12 months"
targets.rawQueryText: WITH nw AS (SELECT date, time, SUM(balance) AS v FROM balances WHERE 1 = 1 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 GROUP BY date) SELECT (SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-30 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "30 days", (SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-90 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "90 days", (SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), 'start of year', '-1 day') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "YTD", (SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-1 year') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "12 months"

panels.description: Change up to the latest exported day. YTD compares with Dec 31. Ignores the time picker.

panels.title: Net worth change %

targets.queryText: WITH nw AS (SELECT date, time, SUM(balance) AS v FROM balances WHERE 1 = 1 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 GROUP BY date) SELECT ((SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-30 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) / ABS((SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-30 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "30 days", ((SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-90 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) / ABS((SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-90 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "90 days", ((SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), 'start of year', '-1 day') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) / ABS((SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), 'start of year', '-1 day') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "YTD", ((SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-1 year') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) / ABS((SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-1 year') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "12 months"
targets.rawQueryText: WITH nw AS (SELECT date, time, SUM(balance) AS v FROM balances WHERE 1 = 1 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 GROUP BY date) SELECT ((SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-30 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) / ABS((SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-30 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "30 days", ((SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-90 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) / ABS((SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-90 days') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "90 days", ((SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), 'start of year', '-1 day') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) / ABS((SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), 'start of year', '-1 day') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "YTD", ((SELECT v FROM nw ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-1 year') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) / ABS((SELECT v FROM nw WHERE date <= date((SELECT MAX(date) FROM nw), '-1 year') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) AS "12 months"

panels.title: Monthly change

targets.queryText: WITH nw AS (SELECT date, time, SUM(balance) AS v FROM balances WHERE 1 = 1 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 GROUP BY date), ends AS (SELECT MAX(date) AS d FROM nw GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)), m AS (SELECT nw.date AS day, nw.time, nw.v - LAG(nw.v) OVER (ORDER BY nw.date) AS delta FROM ends JOIN nw ON nw.date = ends.d) SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', CAST(strftime('%m', day) AS INTEGER) * 3 - 2, 3) || CASE strftime('%m', day) WHEN '01' THEN ' ’' || substr(strftime('%Y', day), 3) ELSE '' END AS "Month", delta AS "Change" FROM m WHERE delta IS NOT NULL AND time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000 ORDER BY day
targets.rawQueryText: WITH nw AS (SELECT date, time, SUM(balance) AS v FROM balances WHERE 1 = 1 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 GROUP BY date), ends AS (SELECT MAX(date) AS d FROM nw GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)), m AS (SELECT nw.date AS day, nw.time, nw.v - LAG(nw.v) OVER (ORDER BY nw.date) AS delta FROM ends JOIN nw ON nw.date = ends.d) SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', CAST(strftime('%m', day) AS INTEGER) * 3 - 2, 3) || CASE strftime('%m', day) WHEN '01' THEN ' ’' || substr(strftime('%Y', day), 3) ELSE '' END AS "Month", delta AS "Change" FROM m WHERE delta IS NOT NULL AND time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000 ORDER BY day

panels.description: Month-end net worth minus the previous month-end (the current month is month-to-date). Last 12 months: earlier history has accounts that were only added to Actual later.

panels.title: Asset mix

targets.queryText: SELECT time, "Cash" / ("Cash" + "Investments" + "Retirement" + "Home equity") AS "Cash", "Investments" / ("Cash" + "Investments" + "Retirement" + "Home equity") AS "Investments", "Retirement" / ("Cash" + "Investments" + "Retirement" + "Home equity") AS "Retirement", "Home equity" / ("Cash" + "Investments" + "Retirement" + "Home equity") AS "Home equity" FROM (SELECT time, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Cash' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Cash", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Investments' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Investments", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Retirement' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Retirement", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Real estate' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Home equity" FROM balances WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 GROUP BY time) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, "Cash" / ("Cash" + "Investments" + "Retirement" + "Home equity") AS "Cash", "Investments" / ("Cash" + "Investments" + "Retirement" + "Home equity") AS "Investments", "Retirement" / ("Cash" + "Investments" + "Retirement" + "Home equity") AS "Retirement", "Home equity" / ("Cash" + "Investments" + "Retirement" + "Home equity") AS "Home equity" FROM (SELECT time, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Cash' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Cash", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Investments' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Investments", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Retirement' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Retirement", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Real estate' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Home equity" FROM balances WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 GROUP BY time) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Share of each asset type over the last 12 months (credit cards and vehicles left out).

panels.title: Assets by type

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Cash' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Cash", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Investments' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Investments", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Retirement' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Retirement", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Real estate' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Home equity" FROM accounts WHERE closed = 0 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Cash' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Cash", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Investments' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Investments", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Retirement' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Retirement", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Real estate' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Home equity" FROM accounts WHERE closed = 0 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0

panels.description: Current balances of open accounts. Credit-card debt is left out of the donut (it is in net worth).

targets.queryText: SELECT CASE type WHEN 'Cash' THEN 'Cash' WHEN 'Investments' THEN 'Investments' WHEN 'Retirement' THEN 'Retirement' WHEN 'HSA' THEN 'HSA' WHEN 'Real estate' THEN 'Home equity' WHEN 'Vehicles' THEN 'Vehicles' WHEN 'Credit cards' THEN 'Credit cards' ELSE type END AS "Type", name AS "Account", balance AS "Balance", balance AS "Share" FROM accounts WHERE closed = 0 AND ABS(balance) >= 1 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 ORDER BY CASE type WHEN 'Cash' THEN 0 WHEN 'Investments' THEN 1 WHEN 'Retirement' THEN 2 WHEN 'HSA' THEN 3 WHEN 'Real estate' THEN 4 WHEN 'Vehicles' THEN 5 WHEN 'Credit cards' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END, balance DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE type WHEN 'Cash' THEN 'Cash' WHEN 'Investments' THEN 'Investments' WHEN 'Retirement' THEN 'Retirement' WHEN 'HSA' THEN 'HSA' WHEN 'Real estate' THEN 'Home equity' WHEN 'Vehicles' THEN 'Vehicles' WHEN 'Credit cards' THEN 'Credit cards' ELSE type END AS "Type", name AS "Account", balance AS "Balance", balance AS "Share" FROM accounts WHERE closed = 0 AND ABS(balance) >= 1 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 ORDER BY CASE type WHEN 'Cash' THEN 0 WHEN 'Investments' THEN 1 WHEN 'Retirement' THEN 2 WHEN 'HSA' THEN 3 WHEN 'Real estate' THEN 4 WHEN 'Vehicles' THEN 5 WHEN 'Credit cards' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END, balance DESC

panels.title: Balance by type over time

targets.queryText: SELECT time, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Cash' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Cash", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Investments' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Investments", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Retirement' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Retirement", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'HSA' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "HSA", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Real estate' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Home equity", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Vehicles' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Vehicles", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Credit cards' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS "Credit cards", SUM(balance) AS "Net worth" FROM balances WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Stacked daily balances per type (negative types stack below zero); the line is net worth. Investment history moves in steps: Actual only records the daily balance adjustments.

panels.title: Projected net worth · ${scenario}

targets.queryText: WITH p(scen, r, c, h) AS (VALUES ('Conservative', 0.0040741237836483535, 0.0016515813019202241, 0.0016515813019202241), ('Base', 0.005654145387405274, 0.0024662697723036864, 0.0024662697723036864), ('Optimistic', 0.007207323316136716, 0.0032737397821989145, 0.0032737397821989145)), s AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Cash' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS cash, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Investments' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS inv, SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Retirement', 'HSA') THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS ret, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Real estate' AND balance > 0 THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS house, SUM(balance) AS total FROM accounts WHERE 1 = 1 AND instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|' || type || '|') = 0), f AS (SELECT CAST('${extra}' AS REAL) * (instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|Investments|') = 0) AS extra, CAST('${retire}' AS REAL) * (instr('|' || '${exclude}' || '|', '|Retirement|') = 0) AS retc, CAST('${dollars}' AS REAL) AS defl, 1.0020598362698427 AS infl, julianday((SELECT MAX(date) FROM balances)) AS start), proj(scen, m, cash, inv, ret, house, fixed, grow, dfl) AS (SELECT scen, 0, cash, inv, ret, house, total - cash - inv - ret - house, 1.0, 1.0 FROM p, s UNION ALL SELECT proj.scen, m + 1, cash * (1 + c), inv * (1 + r) + extra * grow, ret * (1 + r) + retc * grow, house * (1 + h), fixed, grow * infl, dfl * defl FROM proj JOIN p ON p.scen = proj.scen, f WHERE m < 360), pt AS (SELECT proj.*, (julianday((SELECT MAX(date) FROM balances), '+' || m || ' months') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS t, (cash + inv + ret + house + fixed) * dfl AS nw FROM proj) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN m = 60 THEN nw END) AS "In 5 years", MAX(CASE WHEN m = 120 THEN nw END) AS "In 10 years", MAX(CASE WHEN m = 240 THEN nw END) AS "In 20 years", MAX(CASE WHEN m = 360 THEN nw END) AS "In 30 years" FROM pt WHERE scen = '${scenario}'

panels.description: Monthly net worth since October 2025 (the house value was added to Actual in mid-September), then all three scenarios out to the Horizon. Annual nominal returns: Conservative 5% stocks, 2% cash, 2% home; Base 7% stocks, 3% cash, 3% home; Optimistic 9% stocks, 4% cash, 4% home. Contributions rise 2.5%/yr.
